verdict.summary: The outline is A/H/T with Paxos's own bar allocation and monthly ounce figures, which v3 can say. Neither deployment can be read (ERC-20 and Token-2022), the ounce figure covers Ethereum and Solana together with no per-chain denominator, and 'ownership-interest' does not say that the holder's interest is beneficial and pro rata. The vault operator is not named, so the H a buyer needs most has no signer. mechanisms.ts restates PAXG as an origin of kind thing; the research's proportionate beneficial interest reads closer to a share.
